svg.title: 12 pull requests merged into Wikimedia Commons
svg.desc: Open source: 12 pull requests merged into the Wikimedia Commons Android app since October 2026, each fixing an open issue with new tests. #7360, 18 Nov: Previews keep their shape on a failed load. #7345, 18 Nov: Shared photos can keep their location. #7337, 15 Nov: Samsung motion-photo clips removed. #7325, 13 Nov: Photo EXIF dates written in Western digits. #7318, 12 Nov: Long files explain their Detekt exceptions. #7312, 12 Nov: An unused Nearby map check removed. #7296, 10 Nov: Upload count shows 1000+ at the cap. #7284, 10 Nov: Wikitext dates written in Western digits. #7252, 6 Nov: Photo edits survive a rebuilt upload screen. #7071, 2 Nov: Silent upload progress, a bug from 2019. #7184, 27 Oct: Achievements screen split for Detekt. #7069, 24 Oct: Unsupported shared files skipped early.

g.aria-label: Kotlin. Each one fixes an open issue, comes with new Robolectric and Mockito tests, and was merged by the maintainer.
